acceptance_criteria: The service starts against both an empty database and an already-migrated one.
A named test covers configuration resolution at migration time and fails if it regresses.
The service suite and the repository privacy gate pass.

baseline.authority: docs/design/UI2_0_C1_PLATFORM_SCHEMA_CONTRACT.md (FROZEN) keeps Flyway the sole migration authority and separates the migrate role from the application role. Both stand. This movement repairs how the migrate credential reaches the migration step, not who runs it.
baseline.observed: Deployed to HOST-A on 2026-09-15 with every merge of that day. The service entered CrashLoopBackOff on a database that was already migrated, with: SecretFileException: secret file for ui2_migrate.user is unreadable. The worker role started normally; only the service failed.

invariants: Migrations run before any bean reads the schema, and before first-boot seeding.
The migrate credential is read from a file and never from a property value, a default, or an embedded literal.
A missing or unreadable secret still stops start-up.
report.merge_gate: The worker opens the pull request and does not merge it.
report.objective: The service starts again. The empty-database fix made migrations run early enough, and in doing so stopped its own credential paths from being resolved.
output_contract: A SESSION CLOSE on the relay as one NEXUS_SESSION_PACKET.

recommended_reasoning.reason: A Spring lifecycle ordering with two bounds that must both hold, where the obvious repair reintroduces the defect the previous movement fixed.

requirements: State in the pull request how the values are resolved now and why that mechanism runs before the migration but after the environment is available.
The failure message was accurate and the mount was innocent. Do not change the mount, the secret, or the deployment to work around a code-ordering defect.
risks: Reading the environment too early has a mirror failure: reading it too late puts the schema query back before the migration. The pull request should say what guarantees both bounds.
This defect passed unit tests and a verification gate and only appeared in a real deployment. A fix validated the same way proves the same amount.

in: Make the migration step obtain its jdbc url and its two credential paths from resolved configuration, not from values injected into a factory method that runs before resolution.
Keep what #374 achieved: migrations still complete before any bean reads the schema, and still before first-boot identity seeding.

A test that fails if the paths are unresolved at the moment the migration runs -- one that exercises placeholder resolution rather than passing literals. The absence of that test is why this reached a deployment.
out: Reverting to an ApplicationRunner. That reintroduces the empty-database defect #374 fixed, and a product that cannot install is worse than one that needs a restart.
Changing which role applies migrations, or what the migrations do.
Weakening SecretFile. Its fail-closed behaviour is correct and it reported this accurately.

changed: MigrationStartupRunner now resolves the JDBC URL and migrate secret-file paths from Spring Environment when migration runs.
Ui2Application injects Environment instead of early @Value factory parameters.
completed: Repaired migration configuration resolution without changing migration authority, credentials, or lifecycle phase.
Added the named placeholder regression test and opened pull request #382.

integration.ci: Local service suite and privacy gate pass; orchestrator verification pending.
integration.merge_decision: Not merged; merge-mode orchestrator owns verification and merge.

next.objective: Verify startup against empty and already-migrated databases, then merge PR #382 if orchestrator gates pass.

preserved: MigrationStartupRunner remains a highest-priority BeanFactoryPostProcessor before schema-reading beans and first-boot seeding.
The migrate role, migration contents, file-backed credentials, and SecretFile fail-closed behavior are unchanged.

recommended_reasoning.reason: Implementation is narrow and automated gates pass; remaining work is bounded real-environment and merge verification.

unresolved_risks: The original failure was deployment-only, so automated validation does not establish real-environment startup behavior.
